input: The lease a worker holds (key, owner, freshness) and the connection of the database owner inside the transaction of a write.
output: Whether the lease is still that owner's and renewed in time, by the clock of the database; a write of a lost lease is refused.
specification: External audit 2026-10-17 and user 2026-10-18: a worker writes only while it holds its lease; the owner of the database checks the lease in the same transaction as the write.
